section_summary: This section closes a call-sign index from the July 1949 list of Japanese ship and coastal radio stations, then contains two amendments effective 1 September 1949. The first amendment updates ship and coastal stations through additions, changes, deletions, and revised call-sign indexes, while the second revises the geographical list of land, broadcasting, maritime, fishery, police, meteorological, aeronautical, and related radio stations. Entries supply SCAP registration numbers, call signs, frequencies, emission classes, ports or locations, tonnage, operators, and geographic coordinates.

subfiles.title: 1 July 1949 List of Japanese Ship and Coastal Radio Stations: Call-Sign Index (continuation)
subfiles.about: Continuation of an alphabetical call-sign index matching Japanese vessels to SCAP registration numbers.
subfiles.summary: These pages continue a tabular index of Japanese ship radio stations arranged by call sign. Each entry pairs a call sign and SCAP registration number with a vessel name, covering call signs from JQLZ through JRZW. The document clearly began before page 480 and concludes immediately before the amendment title page on page 490.

subfiles.title: First Amendment to the 1 July 1949 List of Japanese Ship and Coastal Radio Stations
subfiles.from: Radio Regulatory Agency, Ministry of Telecommunications
subfiles.about: Amendment adding, changing, and deleting Japanese ship and coastal radio-station records effective 1 September 1949.
subfiles.summary: The amendment changes the standard-frequency transmitting site from Tokyo (Kemigawa) to Tokyo (Koganei) and adds radiobeacons at Hekurajima and Akkeshi. Its main tables add and revise ship stations by administrative region, listing registration number, vessel, port, tonnage, operational agency, call sign, frequencies, power, and emission type. Later sections record deletions and provide call-sign indexes for additions, deletions, and changes.

subfiles.title: First Amendment to the 1 July 1949 List of Japanese Radio Stations
subfiles.from: Radio Regulatory Agency, Ministry of Telecommunications
subfiles.about: Amendment revising the geographical list of Japanese land and broadcasting radio stations effective 1 September 1949.
subfiles.summary: The document first lists geographical additions, giving SCAP registration numbers, frequencies, call signs, power, emission classes, service types, limitations, station locations, and coordinates throughout Japan. Services include domestic fixed, broadcasting, maritime, fishery, police, railroad, radiobeacon, and special-frequency stations. Page 552 begins the corresponding deletions from the geographical list; that deletion schedule is still in progress on page 559.
